name: Alberto del Canto
contribution: A Portuguese noble, military captain, and conquistador who explored northern Mexico on behalf of the Spanish Empire, where he was the founder of several cities for the Viceroy of New Spain.

checks.lead: Alberto del Canto (c. 1547 – 1611), formally Alberto Vieira do Canto, was a Portuguese noble, military captain, and conquistador who explored northern Mexico on behalf of the Spanish Empire, where he was the founder of several cities for the Viceroy of New Spain.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
